title: China urges immediate ceasefire, warns of a widening cycle of violence
content: In a broadcast segment transcribed on CGTN's website, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian called for an immediate halt to military action between the United States, Israel and Iran, warning that continued escalation risked spreading violence further across the region. The spokesperson urged all parties to exercise restraint and return to dialogue. Paraphrased summary, not a verbatim transcript; see the source URL for the original wording.
